title: The Denali Architecture Whitepaper v1.0
description: Deterministic symbolic reasoning architecture for regulatory compliance infrastructure. Specifies the Denali gate, receipt sealing, and the interface to Kerna-Ledger VCI and VERA packets. Companion preprint to the executable engines in Q-Reg, kerna-ledger-vci, and vera-enterprise-engine. Not a substitute for those runtimes.
